RORK — MERGE PR #13 NOW

The workflow repair branch and PR already exist:

- Repository: ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- PR: #13
- Head branch: fix/restore-github-workflows
- Base branch: main
- Fix commit: 341b68ce383f8432c9a399a2f1ffa2b7011c43fd

OBJECTIVE

Merge PR #13 into main and continue the CI verification.

STEP 1 — VERIFY PR

Confirm:

- PR #13 is open
- no merge conflicts
- only the intended .github/workflows files changed
- no secrets were added
- no application source files changed

STEP 2 — MERGE

Merge PR #13 into main.

Return:

- merge status
- merge commit SHA
- new main SHA
- PR state: merged
- merge timestamp

STEP 3 — VERIFY WORKFLOWS ON MAIN

Confirm these files on main are valid YAML:

- .github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml
- .github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml
- .github/workflows/ios-simulator-qa.yml
- the repaired QA workflow

STEP 4 — RUN CI

Trigger or observe fresh runs for:

- IVX CI
- IVX QA Suite
- IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline
- Android Emulator QA
- iOS Simulator QA

Wait for completion.

Return for each workflow:

- workflow name
- run ID
- source SHA
- PASS or FAIL
- exact failed step
- exact error
- next required fix

Do not deploy yet.
Do not build APK yet.
Do not stop after saying the PR is open.

If you cannot merge because owner approval is required, return only:

OWNER_MERGE_REQUIRED

and state the exact GitHub button the owner must press.
